objective: Prevent premature Android Wall photo promotion and ensure unindexed legacy originals use display-aware path with disk cache
productionBaselineEvidence: Previous 2026-10-30 Android production source 646617b500215b27356c55519c548f140e554a21 runtime 1.3.2 update 01a18bdb-50ee-7c4f-928e-b16925cb8c14; screenshot confirms blurry Wall previews and failed tiles while originals open fullscreen. Exact installed update not verified. 209 legacy preview generation failures remain a separate backend issue.
chosenApproach: Render optional sharp originals using Expo Image with stable on-disk cache and onDisplay guarded by decoded dimensions and URL; keep preview underneath and fall back once to native renderer after a real stall
alternativeApproaches: Remove all thumbnails and fetch large originals for every Wall tile (rejected due to weak-network data cost)
Treat native onLoad as confirmed on-screen display (rejected due to prior white-tile incidents)
Deploy new backend transformations without image and cost checks (rejected due to production risk)
selectionRationale: Smallest Android-only change that verifies display before replacing the preview, avoids rerendering unrelated feeds, and reuses the Expo disk cache across remounts
preserveBehaviors: Existing signed URLs and per-account visibility
Tiny private preview remains first paint
No new APK or backend migration
acceptanceChecks: Expo original requires decoded dimensions, matching signed URL and onDisplay before replacing preview
Cache reuse uses original durable path instead of short-lived signed URL
Native fallback is bounded, using same URL, with original preview kept visible
Tests and TypeScript pass before merge
DEV to verified RC to production OTA is mandatory; physical device verification excluded by prior owner instruction
Legacy images with no verified preview index use original Expo display-aware path, not native preview mode
